text: I think films are popular because they tell stories that everybody can understand, even without words. They also give people a chance to escape from daily problems for two hours. Action and comedy films are probably the most popular, because they are easy to enjoy and don't need much thinking. For example, superhero films make a lot of money in almost every country.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.

tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: because they tell stories that everybody can understand

tips.en: A concrete example makes the answer convincing and shows the idea is grounded.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал жауапты сенімді етіп, ойдың негізді екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает ответ убедительным и показывает, что мысль не пустая.
tips.example: For example, superhero films make a lot of money in almost every country

text: Yes, I do. Reading books helps you concentrate for a long time, which is difficult when you're used to short videos. It also improves vocabulary and imagination. I'd say many young people don't read enough, because they prefer scrolling on their phones. But e-books and audiobooks might be a good way to bring them back to reading, since they're more convenient.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: which is difficult when you're used to short videos

tips.en: 'But' offers a solution after the problem.
tips.example: But e-books and audiobooks might be a good way to bring them back to reading

text: I think they should, because arts and culture are part of a country's identity, and many projects can't survive without support. For instance, small theatres and museums often don't earn enough from tickets. But governments shouldn't control the content. I think a good way is to give money to talented artists and let them be free to create what they want.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: because arts and culture are part of a country's identity

tips.en: A qualification makes the position balanced.
tips.example: But governments shouldn't control the content

questions.question: Should governments give money to support arts and culture?

text: I think museums should be more interactive. Young people get bored if they only look at objects behind glass. If museums use technology, like touch screens or virtual reality, the experience becomes more exciting. They could also organise special evenings with music and food, and offer cheaper tickets for students. And social media is useful too, because young people follow what their friends post.

tips.ru: Сложное предложение (условное, пассив, придаточное) повышает Grammatical Range.
